invariants.rationale: The method dereferences tile, so it must be non-null.
The method dereferences tileElement, so it must be non-null.
tileProperties is set to tile.getProperties(), so the returned MapProperties must be non-null.
The 'terrain' property is only put if the attribute from tileElement is non-null.
The 'probability' property is only added if the attribute exists in tileElement.
